_: The real-serve clip. r is seconds on the phone's screen recording. MVI_0927 is 120 fps playing at 30, so real time is its file time / 4, and r = file time / 4 + offset. The offset came from correlating the camera's motion with the app's 3D racket in five separate windows of the session (0.50 to 0.70 s).
